method: Direct primary metadata and relevant original text, reusing documented prior full-text checks where noted. No publication status inferred from search snippets.
version_notes: D3MAS is withdrawn and is omitted from the paper. Its prior verification remains in RELATED_WORK.md. Scaling uses v3; Copies or Sources uses v1. Current arXiv records show no published venue for those cited preprints.

entries.title: Copies or Sources? Measuring How LLM Aggregators Count Restated Evidence in Multi-Agent Systems
entries.inspected_portion: Sections 2, 3 T3, 5.2, 5.3
entries.supported_claim: Restatements and summary protocols are already studied. T3 aggregator reads roster and full log. Our distinction concerns complementary constraints and restricted root access.

entries.title: Epistemic Sybil Resistance: Multiplying AI Agents Without Multiplying Evidence
entries.inspected_portion: Abstract and source-dependence formulation
entries.supported_claim: Separates evidence ancestry, report multiplicity, and correlated extraction errors. Does not imply fresh computations are independent observations.

entries.title: Systematic Failures in Collective Reasoning under Distributed Information in Multi-Agent LLMs
entries.booktitle: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning
entries.inspected_portion: Published record and Sections 6.2-6.4 previously inspected; record rechecked
entries.supported_claim: Information discovery under distributed access and structured communication differ from our complete initial report delivery.

entries.title: Prompt Repetition Improves Non-Reasoning LLMs
entries.note: Preprint; version and primary full text verified 16 October 2026
entries.inspected_portion: Experiments, repetition variants, Appendix A.4
entries.supported_claim: Whole-input repetition is distinct from selective worker-report repetition. API cost claims are not transferred to our GPU.

entries.title: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models

entries.inspected_portion: Camera-ready PDF title page and Section 2; local full text

entries.venue: Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning
entries.inspected_portion: Published PDF title page, introduction and procedure
